channel.title: Feed Harbour example
channel.description: Invented items to demonstrate your reading workspace. Not live news.

item.title: A quieter place for your reading list
item.description: Example item: bring public RSS and Atom feeds into one place. Read the publisher's own summary, mark it read, or save it for later. These demonstration headlines are invented.

item.title: Your saved items travel with you
item.description: Example item: a JSON export preserves subscriptions, imported summaries, read markers and saved items. OPML transfers just your public feed subscriptions and folder names.

item.title: Follow a topic without refreshing ten websites
item.description: Example item: group feeds into folders such as Space, Canada, Linux or Local. Search words across titles and summaries. The reader never scrapes full articles or loads tracking images.
